name: padmoot
title: padmoot
blurb: a social synthesizer / beat pad on atproto. finger-drum on an MPC grid, a Launchpad session grid, or a TR-909 strip — same beat underneath, switchable mid-session. save your pattern straight to your own PDS as a custom lexicon record, export it as JSON/WAV to disk, jam on a moot's shared pattern, or tune into /radio for every pattern anyone's saved on the whole network. @erisianrite.com asked for a social beat pad with a selectable controller layout.
